name: 07927 · Cedar Knolls, NJ
findings: ZIP 07927 (Cedar Knolls) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07927 (Cedar Knolls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07927 (Cedar Knolls) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
